title: Kiwibird52
text: Kiwibird52 is a ten year old (soon to be eleven) who magically finished BA so soon that he got to Intro To Algebra A in less than a year of actual AoPS. He enjoys piano, creative writing, and bubble tea. He has two cats, a piano, and a sister (Crazypenguin84). He is currently learning how to write CSS and JavaScript, and is probably the most music-geeky person on AoPS. In his spare time he likes to compose, improvise, watch the birds in his backyard, and build legos. He CANNOT STAND Alcumus. His favorite part of the courses are the challenge problems. He lives in the Bay Area, CA.
